strategies.name: B8-apex-46
strategies.rationale: bb54-g2's size and hotspot, but kept only when the backbone comes down on position 6 from above the groove axis

strategies.name: B8-span-50
strategies.rationale: hotspots spread along the peptide long axis, so the paratope has to lie along the peptide rather than across the groove and onto the alpha1/alpha2 walls

strategies.name: B8-crest-46
strategies.rationale: the solvent-exposed crest of the bulge only - the three residues whose side chains point out of the groove

strategies.name: B8-apex-54
strategies.rationale: slightly larger than bb54-g2 (never smaller: shrinking is a measured dead end) at a higher MPNN temperature, for topological diversity among shape survivors
